items.title: Duffy Jackson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 17, 1995

ctx.x: Name some of the other — well, I could be picking up names off the floor all day with you I know – but who are some of your really favorite experiences you’ve had? © Fillius Jazz Archive -13-

Well you know we could start at an early age playing with people like Charlie Shavers and Roy Eldridge and Ben Webster. I didn’t even know who these people were but for some reason I just latched on to the groove and whatever my dad played I just went with him. And all of a sudden I’m backing up all these great people and I had no idea what was happening. And you know at four years old I could go [scats] and keep a beat. And you know the whole thing was just keeping a consistent momentum of the groove. Later on I…
